{{Quote|More than that, I spent two years in the Stromma diplomatic enclave at the edge of the Black City. I like these people, and I don't want to see them destroyed.|Stormtrooper Lhagva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species']] '''Stromma diplomatic enclave''' was located at the border of the [[Black City]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Quesoth]] species. At some point, [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Lhagva]], a Stromma, stayed at the enclave for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Lhagva told Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]] that he did not want the Quesoth to be destroyed by the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], remarking that he was fond of the species and telling Sanjin of his stay at the Stromma diplomatic enclave.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stromma diplomatic enclave was mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
